title: Freshers event operations
context: An operations task: planning a freshers' party for incoming students at BITS Pilani.
summary: I planned a freshers' party at BITS Pilani end to end: what happens at the event, where it is held, a week-by-week preparation timeline, the budget, team structure and milestones. The plan also covers a backup venue, sponsorship and a ₹250 ticket to fund it.
points: Total estimated budget of ₹130,000, with ₹60,000 for food for 500-700 students.
Preparation starts four weeks out, with six milestones from team formation to event day.
Six teams of 2-6 members each, from event coordination to security.

list: **Mixer:** an informal session where freshers can meet their batchmates and seniors, promoting interactions and building connections.
**Entertainment:** performances from senior students (music, dance, stand-up comedy), games and a DJ party.
**Introductions:** clubs and departments introduce themselves, plus a "Freshers' Talent Showcase" where juniors are given tasks to show their talents.
**Refreshments:** a buffet with snacks, drinks and desserts.
**Main Auditorium:** main stage for performances and entertainment.
**Rotunda:** space for networking, games and food stalls.

body.p: **Amenities:** sound system and lighting for performances, food stalls or a buffet arrangement, and seating for mingling and conversations.
**Backup plan:** in case of bad weather or any unforeseen circumstances, move the entire event indoors to the Auditorium and IC.
**Event date:** two weeks after the start of the semester.

head: When
Tasks
rows: **Team formation:** identify and assign roles (event coordinators, marketing, logistics, tech, finance). **Finalise venue:** confirm bookings for the Auditorium and Rotunda with the administration. **Collabouration:** bring in the clubs needed for the event (Technical, FMaC, etc.). **Theme:** finalise the event theme and overall vibe. **Budget approval:** get the proposed budget approved by the administration.

**Vendor coordination:** finalise vendors for sound, lighting, catering and decor. **Marketing campaign:** start promotions via social media, posters and word of mouth; open registration for performances and talent showcases. **Event itinerary:** finalise the schedule of performances, games and activities.
**Decor planning:** finalise decor details in line with the theme.

**Tech and logistics check:** rehearsals for performances, final sound and lighting checks. **Final marketing push:** continue promotions to maximise participation. **Security:** coordinate with campus security for safety and crowd management.

**Set-up:** begin venue set-up with decor, seating and food stalls. **Final rehearsal:** last-minute checks and a run-through of the event plan. **Team briefing:** final meeting to review roles and tasks for the day.

head: Head
Amount
Covers
rows: Sound system, lighting and technical support
Themed decor for the networking and entertainment areas; branding materials, posters and standees
Buffet and snacks for 500-700 students; soft drinks and water
DJ; prizes for games and competitions
Posters, social media campaigns and registration platform
Emergency funds for last-minute expenses; security, transport and coordination

list: Reach out to local businesses (cafes, food brands) or tech companies for sponsorship in exchange for branding during the event.
Make it a ticketed event, charging freshers ₹250 each.

head: Team
Size
Role
rows: Oversees all aspects of the event and ensures seamless execution
Handles promotions, registration and social media engagement
Manages set-up, sound, lighting and technical needs
Coordinates with vendors and manages food and beverages
Organises performances, games and the DJ set-up
Coordinates with campus security and makes sure safety protocols are followed

list: **Venue:** campus spaces like the Auditorium and Rotunda are easily accessible and have adequate capacity.

**Budget:** with student and sponsor funding, the budget is realistic and manageable. Most of the spend goes on venue logistics, food and entertainment, which keeps quality high while staying within limits.
**Team coordination:** a clear division of roles and firm deadlines will keep execution smooth, with regular team meetings to keep everyone on track.

body.p: The Freshers Party balances fun with chances for networking and community-building. With a clear timeline, budget and resource allocation, the plan gives every fresher an enjoyable experience and helps them start their BITS Pilani journey on a positive note.
